name: Providers
descr: The providers of the goods, the groups they stand in and the options hung on them. The option tree - provider_key with the values of provider_key_value - belongs to the program and is only read here; the providers, their groups and the rows of provider_key_set are what this tool writes. A goods points at its provider by store.provider_id, the Price tool writes it, and a currency of one provider points back by currency.provider_id.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the groups and the providers standing in them - two tables. The warehouses and the option rows come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the family whole - the groups, the providers, the warehouses of every provider and the option rows standing on providers and warehouses: five tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes providers by id. The first call counts the goods and the currencies pointing at them, the second one does it: store.provider_id and currency.provider_id are emptied, the rows that hung on the providers are swept by the map of the engine, and what orders already carry stays as written.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the provider, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

params.name: relation
params.descr: true - the references pointing at these rows are emptied as well; left out, they stay as they are

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the providers in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on providers: one row of provider_key_set on each of them. The option and its value must stand in the tree of the provider options, and a stray id is refused.

params.name: provider_id
params.descr: id of the provider, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the provider_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - provider_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of provider_key_set, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A row keeps whatever the call leaves out, and the pair it will stand with is weighed against the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of provider_key_set, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the provider_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - provider_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of provider_key_set by id. The option itself stays in the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of provider_key_set, or several of them
